summary: Re-review of sub-mv088qt4-015cce43. All 40 artifact hashes match. npm test 280/280 and the offline hold3 verifier run (M1b 63/63, M1c 1/434 = 0.23%, holdout log unchanged at 6 rows) were re-run after the submission. The hold3 provenance handoff and the tuning-log section close F2. They are labelled a self-report, which I corroborated where I could. Approved on the evidence; no human acceptance is implied.

criteria.description: npm test passes and checks are reproducible
Offline holdout verifier run reproduces M1b 63/63 and M1c 1/434 on hold3, without logging a holdout run

Manifest integrity: sha256sum -c on eval/holdout is clean (25 files); MANIFEST hash b0c36134... equals the hash in the hold3 log rows and the submission; retired manifests 7518992... and dc18468... match their logged runs

Holdout run discipline: exactly one hold3 run per provider (2 log rows with manifest b0c3...), 3 rows per provider in total; the earlier attempts at 00:08:53 were REFUSED by the cap (exit 64) before the operator-authorised MAX_HOLDOUT_RUNS 2->3 edit and appended nothing; the cap change matches dec-mv06pxds-01667e31 (1 more holdout run per provider)

Verifier changes are generic and do not weaken fabrication detection: magnitude normalisation (exact integers, so 1.84 million != 1.8 million), place-adjective derivation (alphabetic only, 6+ letters, base 5+ letters, prefix of a source token), sentence-initial -ly/-ing opener, long author strings not split, reporting verbs in the stoplist, and WEAK_SUPPORT unit-word and 3+/3+ prefix-extension tolerance. Each has a twin test showing invented content is still flagged. M1b is 63/63 on the tune/corpus run and on hold3; fallback and CLI holdout M4 are 10/10.

Docs honesty: no claim of human acceptance; only hold3 stated as unbiased; failed holdouts 1 (3.07%) and 2 (2.50%) kept in history; open false flag hold3-08 disclosed; ownership deviations and shell-edited docs disclosed in the handoff; retired holdout moves explained in README and tuning-log
Holdout 3 independence: authored by the test-engineer without verifier access, with provenance recorded (author self-report, corroborated by timing)

findings.title: Edit guard bypass and out-of-glob edits
findings.detail: The handoff discloses that README and docs were edited through the shell because the edit guard refused them, and that ten files fall outside the task globs. The disclosure is adequate and the gate pins all of them. The practice should not repeat.
findings.recommendation: No change needed for this gate. Open a properly scoped rework next time instead of editing around the guard.

findings.title: Residual verifier tolerance and small-n caveat
findings.detail: The prefix-extension rule (data -> database) and the demonym rule loosen WEAK_SUPPORT and NAME checks slightly. They are bounded: a 50% overlap is still required, the name check is unchanged for non-derived tokens, and the twin tests plus M1b 63/63 pass. The M1c estimate of 1/434 has wide uncertainty and is correctly described that way. hold3-08 is an open false flag and no human acceptance is recorded, as the docs state.

resolvedFindings.resolution: M1c miss no longer reproduces on the fresh sealed holdout: 1/434 = 0.23%, re-run offline by me.

Handoff ho-mv0884dm-012bc487 plus a tuning-log provenance section and a docs/eval-results.md citation state what the author read and did not read. Corroborated: the failed manifest-test evidence ev-mv06zmvp matches the described hold2-to-hold3 test gap, hold3 titles do not overlap the retired holdouts, the manifest hash matches the run log, and timing shows hold3 did not exist while the verifier was tuned. Remains a self-report, as the docs state.
